hydro-jetting-vs-snaking.h1: Hydro jetting vs snaking for an Ottawa sewer or drain clog
hydro-jetting-vs-snaking.intro: A drain cable can open a path through an obstruction, while hydro jetting can wash buildup from the inside of a suitable pipe. In an Ottawa home, the right choice depends on where the blockage is, what caused it and whether the pipe can withstand the work.

ps: A drain snake uses a rotating cable to break through or pull out an obstruction. It can be a sensible first step for an isolated clog, especially when the cause and location are straightforward. Opening the blockage may restore flow without removing all residue along the pipe wall.

A jetting nozzle directs pressurized water into a line to break up and flush material such as grease or sludge. It may clean more of the pipe interior when repeated clogs come from wall buildup. Pipe material and condition matter, so a professional should not assume that a fragile or damaged line is a good candidate.

A line under an older home may be more fragile than one in a recent build. Roots and wet ground near the river can also change what is practical. Start by learning what the pipe is made of and where the blockage sits.
